WITH target_src AS
(
      SELECT
        m.*,
        NULLIF(m.partition_clause, '')::jsonb AS partition_json
    FROM "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_target_master m
    WHERE  m.init_wait_yn = 'Y'
      AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
      AND m.data_class = 'RAW'
      AND m.exec_group = '@{variables('pv_exec_group')}'
),

partition_src AS
(
    SELECT
        m.*,

        m.partition_json ->> 'partition_column'
            AS partition_column,

        UPPER(m.partition_json ->> 'partition_range')
            AS partition_range,

        UPPER(m.partition_json ->> 'data_type')
            AS partition_data_type,

        p.partition_val

    FROM target_src m

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL
    (
        SELECT x AS partition_val
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
            m.partition_json -> 'partition_val'
        ) AS j(x)
    ) p
        ON TRUE
),

query_src AS
(
    SELECT
        m.*,

        /*
         * 파티션 WHERE 조건 생성
         */
        CASE

            /* 파티션 미사용 */
            WHEN m.partition_json IS NULL
              OR m.partition_val IS NULL
            THEN ''

            /*
             * INVALID
             * STRING + MONTHLY/YEARLY(clym YYYYMM 기준)
             */
            WHEN m.partition_val = 'INVALID'
             AND m.partition_data_type = 'STRING'
            THEN
                ' WHERE ('
                || m.partition_column
                || ' IS NULL'
                || ' OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE('
                || m.partition_column
                || ', ''^[0-9]{6}$'')'
                || ' OR SUBSTR('
                || m.partition_column
                || ', 5, 2) NOT BETWEEN ''01'' AND ''12'''
                || ')'

            /*
             * DATE / TIMESTAMP INVALID
             * 타입 컬럼이므로 비정상 문자열은 존재할 수 없고
             * NULL만 INVALID 처리
             */
            WHEN m.partition_val = 'INVALID'
             AND m.partition_data_type IN ('DATE', 'TIMESTAMP')
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' IS NULL'

            /*
             * STRING + MONTHLY
             * ex) clym = '202601'
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'STRING'
             AND m.partition_range = 'MONTHLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' = '''
                || m.partition_val
                || ''''

            /*
             * STRING + YEARLY
             * clym 컬럼은 YYYYMM 형태
             *
             * 2026
             * => 202601 <= clym < 202701
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'STRING'
             AND m.partition_range = 'YEARLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= '''
                || m.partition_val
                || '01'''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < '''
                || ((m.partition_val::int + 1)::text)
                || '01'''

            /*
             * DATE + MONTHLY
             *
             * 202601
             * => 2026-01-01 ~ 2026-02-01
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'DATE'
             AND m.partition_range = 'MONTHLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= '''
                || TO_CHAR(
                       TO_DATE(m.partition_val || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'),
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'
                   )
                || ''''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < '''
                || TO_CHAR(
                       TO_DATE(m.partition_val || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
                       + INTERVAL '1 month',
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'
                   )
                || ''''

            /*
             * DATE + YEARLY
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'DATE'
             AND m.partition_range = 'YEARLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= '''
                || m.partition_val
                || '-01-01'''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < '''
                || ((m.partition_val::int + 1)::text)
                || '-01-01'''

            /*
             * TIMESTAMP + MONTHLY
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'TIMESTAMP'
             AND m.partition_range = 'MONTHLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= TIMESTAMP '''
                || TO_CHAR(
                       TO_DATE(m.partition_val || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'),
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'
                   )
                || ' 00:00:00'''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < TIMESTAMP '''
                || TO_CHAR(
                       TO_DATE(m.partition_val || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
                       + INTERVAL '1 month',
                       'YYYY-MM-DD'
                   )
                || ' 00:00:00'''

            /*
             * TIMESTAMP + YEARLY
             */
            WHEN m.partition_data_type = 'TIMESTAMP'
             AND m.partition_range = 'YEARLY'
            THEN
                ' WHERE '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' >= TIMESTAMP '''
                || m.partition_val
                || '-01-01 00:00:00'''
                || ' AND '
                || m.partition_column
                || ' < TIMESTAMP '''
                || ((m.partition_val::int + 1)::text)
                || '-01-01 00:00:00'''

            ELSE ''

        END AS partition_where

    FROM partition_src m
),

ins AS
(
    INSERT INTO "ADFADM".ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        ingest_pipeline_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,

        data_class,
        ingest_type,
        src_type,
        target_id,

        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

        exec_group,
        condition_type,
        condition_frequency,
        condition_interval,

        incr_column_nm,
        incr_column_type,
        incr_column_hw_val,
        incr_start_val,

        init_wait_yn,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        file_size_mb,
        start_dt,
        end_dt,

        extract_cnt,
        save_cnt,
        attempt_no,

        status,
        error_log,

        created_by,
        created_dt
    )

    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}',
        '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',

        '-',

        'PL_'
        || m.data_class
        || '_'
        || m.src_type
        || '_'
        || CASE
               WHEN NULLIF(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm, '') IS NOT NULL
               THEN m.cdc_tgt_db_nm
               ELSE m.src_db_nm
           END,

        m.data_class,
        m.ingest_type,
        m.src_type,
        m.target_id,

        m.src_db_nm,
        m.src_schema_nm,
        m.src_table_nm,

        m.cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

        m.exec_group,
        m.condition_type,
        m.condition_frequency,
        m.condition_interval,

        m.incr_column_nm,
        m.incr_column_type,
        m.incr_column_hw_val,
        m.incr_column_hw_val,

        m.init_wait_yn,

        /*
         * extract_query
         */
        CASE
            /*
             * DB2
             */
            WHEN UPPER(m.src_type) = 'DB2'
            THEN
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || COALESCE(
                       NULLIF(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm, ''),
                       m.src_schema_nm
                   )
                || '.'
                || m.src_table_nm
                || m.partition_where
                || ' WITH UR ;'

            /*
             * MSSQL
             */
            WHEN UPPER(m.src_type) = 'MSSQL'
            THEN
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || m.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || m.src_table_nm
                || ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                || m.partition_where
                || ' ;'

            /*
             * PostgreSQL 및 기타
             */
            ELSE
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || m.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || m.src_table_nm
                || m.partition_where
                || ' ;'

        END,

        /*
         * landing_path
         *
         * partition 있을 경우:
         * .../clym=202601/
         *
         * 없으면 기존 경로
         */
        m.data_class
        || '/batch_date=@{substring(variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss'),0,8)}'
        || '/batch_hour=@{substring(variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss'),8,2)}'
        || '/pipeline_name=@{pipeline().Pipeline}/',

        /*
         * file_name
         *
         * partition:
         * DB.SCHEMA.TABLE.202601.timestamp.parquet
         *
         * no partition:
         * DB.SCHEMA.TABLE.timestamp.parquet
         */
        m.src_db_nm
        || '.'
        || m.src_schema_nm
        || '.'
        || m.src_table_nm
        || CASE
               WHEN m.partition_val IS NOT NULL THEN
                   '.' || CASE 
                               WHEN m.partition_val = 'INVALID' 
                               THEN m.partition_val || '_' || m.partition_range 
                               ELSE m.partition_val 
                          END
               ELSE ''
           END
        || '.@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'
        || '.parquet',

        0,

        NOW(),
        NULL,

        0,
        0,
        0,

        'PENDING',

        NULL,

        'ADF',
        NOW()

    FROM query_src m

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,

        data_class,
        ingest_type,
        src_type,
        target_id,

        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

        exec_group,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        attempt_no,
        status
)

SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    master_pipeline_nm,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,

    data_class,
    ingest_type,
    src_type,
    target_id,

    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,

    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

    exec_group,

    extract_query,
    landing_path,
    file_name,

    attempt_no,
    status

FROM ins

ORDER BY
    target_id,
    file_name;
